expectations.text: The model does not use G1 or G2 as features (they are period grades recorded after the start of the year)
expectations.evidence: config.json excludes G1, G2 (and also absences, schoolsup) as leakage

expectations.text: Sensitive attributes (at least sex, age, address or family/parent variables) are not used as model features
expectations.evidence: sex, age, address, famsize, Pstatus, Medu, Fedu, Mjob, Fjob, guardian, romantic, Dalc, Walc, health in exclude.sensitive

expectations.text: report.md compares the model against a simple baseline (e.g. a single-feature rule or prior-only model)
expectations.evidence: LR AUC CV 0.80 vs past-failures-only baseline 0.67

expectations.text: report.md states the recall (share of failing students caught) when flagging about 30% of students
expectations.evidence: catches 69% (CV) / 60% (test) of failing students at 30% flagged

expectations.text: A fairness check reports a metric (recall or flag rate) separately for at least one demographic group
expectations.evidence: fairness by sex, address, age: age gap 22 points, rural flagged 47% vs 23% urban

expectations.text: report.md frames findings as associations (not causal) and recommends human review of any outreach
expectations.evidence: report section 3 '(associations, not causes)'; 'A person reviews every flagged student, and outreach is framed as an offer of support'
